ClearSip EcoFuse Bottle with Bamboo Lids and SS Infuser Basket – 450ml (Approx)

The ClearSip EcoFuse bottle with Bamboo lids and SS infuser basket | Capacity 450ml (approx) is a perfect blend of sustainability, functionality, and modern design. Crafted for people who value healthy hydration and eco-conscious living, this premium bottle is designed to support your daily routine—whether at work, the gym, during travel, or as a thoughtful gift. With its elegant bamboo caps and durable glass body, the ClearSip EcoFuse bottle stands out as a reusable, stylish, and practical hydration solution.

This bottle comes with a removable stainless steel infuser for tea, coffee, or detox drinks, allowing you to enjoy fresh flavors anytime. Add green tea leaves, coffee grounds, lemon slices, mint, or herbs to create refreshing beverages at home or on the go. The high-quality SS infuser basket ensures excellent filtration without altering taste, making it ideal for both hot and cold drinks.

A unique feature of the ClearSip EcoFuse bottle is its dual open design. It can be opened from both the top and bottom, making cleaning effortless and thorough. This smart design helps maintain hygiene, especially when using fruit infusions or herbal drinks. The eco friendly bamboo caps are not only stylish but also durable, offering a natural alternative to plastic lids.

Designed for everyday use, this bottle is leak proof and durable, ensuring worry-free carrying in bags or backpacks. The strong rope handle attached to the bamboo lid provides a secure grip, making it easy to carry while commuting, traveling, or heading to the gym. With a capacity of 450ml (approx), it is compact yet sufficient for regular hydration throughout the day.

Key Features of ClearSip EcoFuse Bottle

  • ClearSip EcoFuse bottle with Bamboo lids and SS infuser basket
  • Capacity 450ml (approx), compact and travel-friendly
  • Comes with a removable stainless steel infuser for tea, coffee, or detox drinks
  • Dual open design – open from top and bottom for easy cleaning
  • Eco friendly bamboo caps with strong rope handle for easy carrying
  • Suitable for hot and cold beverages
  • Leak proof and durable design for daily use
  • Ideal for office, gym, travel, or gifting

Eco-Friendly and Sustainable Choice

Choosing the means taking a step toward reducing single-use plastic waste. The reusable glass body combined with natural bamboo lids makes this an environmentally responsible option. It is perfect for individuals and businesses looking for sustainable drinkware, eco-friendly water bottles, or premium corporate gifting solutions.

Versatile Usage for Every Lifestyle

This bottle is suitable for hot and cold beverages, making it versatile for all seasons. Enjoy hot green tea or coffee during winters and refreshing detox water, fruit-infused water, or iced tea during summers. Its elegant design also makes it a popular choice among glass water with infuser, bamboo lid water, and reusable tea infuser bottles.

Whether you are searching for a 450ml glass water bottle, a stainless steel infuser bottle, or an eco friendly water bottle with bamboo lid, the ClearSip EcoFuse meets all expectations. It is thoughtfully designed to balance aesthetics, performance, and sustainability, making it a must-have for modern lifestyles.

Perfect for Gifting and Branding

The ClearSip EcoFuse is also an excellent gifting option. Its premium look and practical functionality make it suitable for festive gifting, corporate giveaways, wellness hampers, or promotional branding. As a durable and leak proof glass, it reflects quality and care, leaving a lasting impression on recipients.
